verdict.rationale: Omnara is a platform for running and managing agents. Automated security-alert validation and remediation via pull request is a fair capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows only general building blocks (MCP servers, custom tools, skills, event webhooks) and has no documented security-alert ingestion, validation, remediation, or PR-opening feature.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have security alerts automatically validated and remediated with an opened pull request
